request.description: ONE single free-standing bay of a horse-racing starting gate (a starting stall), empty, no horse: a boxy dark racing-green painted welded steel frame on two small black wheels, a tall vertical square post at the front and one at the back joined by a flat top rail truss, low green padded side boarding between the posts with thin steel bars above it, a white and green closed padded front gate slab at the front right edge, a blank white square number board on top of the frame, ground shadowless, strict perfect side profile view, looking exactly along the running rail: zero perspective, no front view, no three-quarter view, the whole sprite is seen from the side and faces right (the direction of travel), HD pixel art with fine detail and many small pixels, high-res pixel art, crisp hand-pixelled look, selective dark outlines, rich shading, warm golden-hour English racecourse palette: honey sunlight, deep racing greens, cream, transparent background

style_image.usage_description: match ONLY this pixel art style, palette, line weight and shading; ignore its camera angle completely
